lines.en: We were waiting until Carly got here to make the official announcement.
But I guess the cat's out of the bag.
Spencer and I are getting married.
I don't want you going to that fight either.
Look, I've seen those MMA fights.
I don't think it's a place for kids.
Okay, when did you suddenly turn uncool?
Uh, when did you turn into a little baby who yells at me the first time she doesn't get what she wants?
Right, when you stopped giving me what I want!
Uh, this is her homework schedule and the number for a good tutor 'cause she's been having some trouble with science.
Oh, and these are the vitamins she needs to take every day.
I only give her the ones shaped like dinosaurs.
